principle: score each channel separately; NO aggregate; the object of measurement is the GAP between semantic content and its typed slot

axes.E_edge: sub-scored: E_localize (is the faulty arrow identified anywhere in the output?) and E_type (is edge_type a specific typed class, not a generic label?)
axes.W_warrant: are the missing licenses stated as warrants (what WOULD license the arrow), precise and sufficient?
axes.M_laundering: is the claim-to-fact laundering compiled INTO the morphism_laundering field (not merely described in prose)?
axes.R_rivals: is the premise-licensed rival hypothesis listed?
axes.C_schema: sub-scored: C_formal (strict JSON, all fields, types, enum) and C_slots (semantic content allocated to its intended field)

scorer: shell hand-rubric v0 (criteria above, deterministic and auditable; mechanization = V1 candidate)
